content.overview: The Registrar may remove a name under s. 248. The Tribunal may restore it under s. 252.
content.glance: The Registrar may remove a name under s. 248. The Tribunal may restore it under s. 252.
content.study: Company-initiated strike-off requires liabilities to be extinguished and no s. 248(3) bar. Registrar-initiated strike-off follows notice. An application to restore may be made by the company, member, creditor or workman within the periods in s. 252, and the name may be restored if the removal was not justified or otherwise as the section allows.
